Project Description: "Interactive Globe"
Our project is an interactive digital globe that allows users to explore countries and observe changes occurring on our planet across different time periods.
Upon opening the project, the user sees a globe divided into continents. By selecting a continent, they can navigate to a list of countries. Each country's page displays its capital and key geographical information.
The main feature of the project is the ability to observe a country's condition during a specific time period. Users can view changes in vegetation, wildfires, anomalies, and snow cover, if present in that territory. Color coding is also used for countries to visually represent these changes.
Special attention is given to the musical accompaniment. When switching between countries, the music changes automatically, and its sound is tailored to the selected country and time period. In this way, music becomes an additional medium for conveying information about the state of the territory.
The goal of the project is to combine geography, visualization of natural processes, and music to show the Earth not merely as a map, but as a constantly changing system that can be explored across space and time.
details:
Project Description: “Interactive Globe”

Our project is an interactive digital globe that allows users to explore countries around the world and observe environmental changes across different periods of time.

How the Project Works

When users open the application, they see an interactive globe divided into continents. After selecting a continent, they can access a list of countries located on it. Each country’s page provides basic geographical information, including its capital and other key characteristics.

The main feature of the project is the ability to explore environmental changes in a selected country over a specific period of time. Users can observe changes in vegetation, natural wildfires, climate anomalies, and snow cover. In addition, color-coded indicators are used to make it easier to identify and understand changes across different territories.

Another unique feature is the adaptive musical accompaniment. When users switch between countries, the background music changes automatically according to the selected country and time period.

Project Advantages

* An interactive and visual approach to learning geography.

* The ability to observe environmental changes over time.

* Integration of geographical data, visualizations, and musical accompaniment.

* Convenient navigation between continents and countries.

* Increased interest in natural processes through a combination of visual and auditory experiences.

Expected Project Impact

The project aims to increase environmental awareness and encourage users to learn more about our planet. It helps users better understand environmental changes, pay attention to natural phenomena, and recognize the impact of various processes on different regions.

In the future, the project could be used for educational purposes, particularly in geography, ecology, and natural science classes. It may also encourage people to develop a more responsible attitude toward the environment.

Development Technologies and Tools

The project is being developed as a web application. Its creation involves web development tools, software for geographical data visualization, and technologies for building the user interface. The project also uses geographical and environmental data to display changes across different territories.

Creative Approach

The main creative idea behind the project is to combine three elements: geography, environmental monitoring, and music. We wanted to present Earth not simply as a static map, but as a dynamic system that is constantly changing.

Special attention is given to musical accompaniment. Music is not just a decorative element; it serves as an additional way to create an emotional connection between users, the selected country, and the chosen time period.

Factors Considered During Development

During the development process, our team takes the following factors into account:

* The accuracy and relevance of geographical and environmental information.

* Clear and understandable visualization of environmental changes.

* A convenient and user-friendly interface.

* Accurate representation of data for different countries and time periods.

* Integration of visual and audio elements.

* Accessibility for users with different levels of geographical knowledge.

In conclusion, Interactive Globe is an educational project that combines technology, geography, ecology, and art to offer a new way of exploring our planet.
